questions.question: What was Craig Kelly's position on the Financial System Legislation Amendment (Resilience and Collateral Protection) Bill 2016 in parliament?

expected.answer: Craig Kelly spoke on the Financial System Legislation Amendment (Resilience and Collateral Protection) Bill 2016 on 2 May 2016 (speech-331703). The speaker argued that the Financial System Legislation Amendment (Resilience and Collateral Protection) Bill 2016 is needed to allow Australian entities to comply with international margining requirements for over-the-counter derivatives from September 2016, clarifying domestic law on termination rights and netting contracts. He also criticised the previous Labor government's GFC response, claiming it wasted billions on pink batts, school halls, and border protection, leaving a debt costing a person on $80,000 income $628 in annual interest.

must.why: the speaker is named
